data.description: GlideWebpDecoder 是一个 Glide 集成库，用于在 Android 平台上解码和显示 webp 图像。它基于 libwebp 项目，并以 Fresco 和 GlideWebpSupport 的一些实现作为参考。
data.label: GlideWebpDecoder

data.description: GlideWebpDecoder is a Glide integration library for decoding and displaying webp images on the Android platform. It is based on the libwebp project and refers to some implementations of Fresco and GlideWebpSupport.
data.label: GlideWebpDecoder
